name: Xylose minimal medium (M9 + E4P supplements + xylose) (PMC7669889)
description: xylose minimal medium (M9 + E4P supplements + xylose) — medium reported in PMC7669889 (complex/undefined base — extracts not BiGG-mappable).

provenance.citation: Medium composition from PMC7669889 (see GrowthDB record).
provenance.notes: Complex medium: chemically-defined portion mapped to BiGG; biological extracts listed in `unmapped`. Added via GrowthDB curation.
provenance.base_expansion: Base 'M9' expanded to standard composition: M9 minimal medium (Sambrook & Russell 2001): Na2HPO4, KH2PO4, NaCl, NH4Cl, MgSO4, CaCl2 + carbon source.
provenance.verification_evidence: M9 minimal medium (47.8 mM Na2HPO4, 22 mM KH2PO4, 8.6 mM NaCl, 18.7 mM NH4Cl, 2 mM MgSO4 and 100 μM CaCl2), supplemented with trace elements (134 μM EDTA, 31 μM FeCl3·6H2O, 6.2 μM ZnCl2, 0.76 μM CuCl2·2H2O, 0.42 μM CoCl2·2H2O, 1.62 μM H3BO3, 0.081 μM MnCl2·4H2O). E4P Supplements: 1 mM shikimic acid, 1 μM pyridoxine, 250 μM tyrosine, 500 μM phenylalanine, 200 μM tryptophan, 6 μM 4-aminobenzoic acid
